critical_evidence.evidence: No service records in the captured listing. Brake fluid on a 2023 car is at or near its 3-year interval.
The early-6MT failure pattern applies to 2016 and early-2017 ND1 builds. This 2023 ND2 carries revised internals. Still confirm a clean, quiet shift at the PPI.
No footwell or drain-area photos examined here. Soft-top car.
NHTSA campaign 24V695000 (airbag control module software, 2016-2023 MX-5) applies to this model year. Closure status is not shown.

documentation.rationale: The identity and terms half is present: VIN that decodes cleanly, itemised price with the $85 doc fee, and a history summary showing single owner and no reported accident. The maintenance half is missing: no service records, no Carfax attached, and no photos of at-risk areas such as footwells, drains or tire dates.

condition.rationale: No faults are stated. One studio photo shows straight, glossy paint, an intact top and stock wheels. Nothing about the underside, tires, leaks or cabin water has been examined. At 3 years and 36k miles the car is low-risk by age, but its condition is unproven.

price_value.rationale: $23,941 is about 8% above the $22,226 fair-value midpoint, though inside the $18.3k-26.7k range. It is reasonable for a 2023 ND2 manual, but not discounted. A 2021 Sport with 61k miles is asking $23,034 nearby. No known-work items pull the figure down.

mission_fit.rationale: Manual, the newest ND2 engine, and highly reliable. Resale in 6-24 months should be easy, and the price is under the $27,000 ceiling. It sits above the $19,000 ideal-high, and the base Sport trim limits the point of view slightly.

logistics.rationale: California dealer 254 miles away. PPI by the buyer's mechanic is explicitly offered, smog is claimed passed, and it is a straightforward fly-and-drive from the LA area.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: Soul Red ND2 manual is a desirable combination. It is base Sport cloth trim with no Club or Brembo/BBS package, and it is the soft top rather than the RF.

ppi_focus: Scan for stored codes and confirm airbag recall 24V695000 is closed via Mazda dealer VIN lookup
Clutch slip in 4th-6th under load, engagement height, warm-gearbox shift quality into 2nd/3rd
Tire DOT dates, tread depth and shoulder wear (abuse indicator); brake pad and rotor thickness

Underside: rear diff pinion/output seals, valve cover and front crank seal seepage, water pump weep hole

Brake fluid moisture test; battery health test; infotainment and CarPlay function
what_would_change_verdict: Up: a full Carfax showing regular dealer service, a closed airbag recall and no rental use, plus a clean PPI.
Up: tires with recent date codes and good tread, or a price concession toward the $22k fair-value midpoint.
Down: evidence of track or autocross use, a slipping clutch or grinding gearbox, or paint-meter evidence of an unreported repair.
Down: a branded title, rental history, or mandatory dealer add-ons inflating the out-the-door price.
evidence.mission_note: A 2023 ND2 manual fits the enthusiast-bridge brief directly. It is reliable, has a real point of view, and should resell quickly, though its price sits above the ideal band and below the ceiling. Accelerated-bridge mode still calls for a PPI and recall check before money moves.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes identity and terms well. The VIN decodes to a 2023 MX-5 Sport 2.0L convertible matching the ad. The price is itemised at $23,941 plus an $85 doc fee. The Autotrader history summary reports a single owner and no accident or damage. Photo 1 shows a Soul Red car with an intact black top and apparently stock black wheels; the other attached photos are different dealer inventory, not this car. Nothing wrong is observed or disclosed. However, there are no service records, tire dates, cabin or drain photos, or underside evidence. NHTSA recall 24V695000 applies to this model year, and its closure is unconfirmed. The asking price is roughly 8% above the fair-value midpoint but inside the comp range. The dealer explicitly offers a buyer's-mechanic inspection and claims smog is passed, so the open items are all answerable before purchase.
evidence.next_action: Call or text the dealer at [phone] to request the full Carfax, the recall 24V695000 closure status, tire DOT dates and the out-the-door figure, and to schedule an independent PPI in the Pacoima area.
